data.long_meaning: Dheemant is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘dhi’ which means ‘intellect’ and ‘mant’ meaning ‘protection’. This name symbolizes a powerful and fearless individual, one who uses their intellect to protect and serve.

in_sanskrit.name: धीमान्त
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: धी: intellect, mind, understanding, wisdom, insight. मान्त: to be, exist. धीमान्त: One who has a brilliant intellect or mind.
